verdict.rationale: Braintrust's API reference explicitly claims programmatic access to "all aspects of the Braintrust platform", listing projects, experiments, datasets, traces, prompts, tools, and scorers. SDKs, the `bt` CLI, and an official MCP server also cover logs, evals, monitoring, Topics, and function management. Parity is asserted by the vendor but not verified item by item; the OpenAPI probe found no spec only at the guessed paths, which does not contradict the claim. missing for 10: evidence of API parity for UI-centric features (playgrounds, custom annotation interfaces, Loop/Patterns, permission groups), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI/API parity
